description: This file implements the SystemDnsConfigChangeNotifier class, which manages DNS configuration change notifications, including observer management, configuration refresh, and testing hooks.

classes.name: WrappedObserver
classes.description: Handles posting DNS config change notifications to an observer in a thread-safe manner.

classes.name: SystemDnsConfigChangeNotifier::Core
classes.description: Manages the core logic of DNS configuration change notifications, including observer management, config updates, and testing support.

methods.name: WrappedObserver::OnNotifyThreadsafe
methods.description: Posts a notification to the observer in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: WrappedObserver::OnNotify
methods.description: Invokes the observer's callback with the DNS config.

methods.name: SystemDnsConfigChangeNotifier::Core::AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer to the notifier, immediately notifying if config is available.

methods.name: SystemDnsConfigChangeNotifier::Core::RemoveObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer from the notifier.

methods.name: SystemDnsConfigChangeNotifier::Core::RefreshConfig
methods.description: Triggers a refresh of the DNS configuration.

methods.name: SystemDnsConfigChangeNotifier::Core::SetDnsConfigServiceForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom DNS config service for testing purposes.
